zh-CN.title: 消息同步稳定性
items: 修复部分设备上用户状态正常更新、但新消息停止同步的问题
隐私锁定期间继续安全推进消息同步，解锁后无需等待或重新加载

en.title: More reliable message sync
items: Fixed an issue where account state could keep updating while new message sync stopped on some devices
Message sync now advances safely while privacy lock is active, so unlocking no longer requires waiting or reloading
